name: FELT PIANO
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless generated solo piano. Felt hammers, a soft pedal, a quiet room.
description: FELT PIANO turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into an endless solo pianist. Every few minutes a new piece in one of twelve idioms: Gymnopedie-like waltz, Airport-style loops, felt ostinato, nocturne, modal improvising, Glass-style arpeggios, four-part hymn, slow stride ballad, Debussy-style planing, 6/8 lullaby, slow 12/8 blues or minor blues. A modal felt-piano voice with soft hammers, dampers, sympathetic strings, pedal and key noise, in a gentle room; a piano roll scrolls on the screen. Thirty-three presets, from Erik's Bowler to Spare Key.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
